'''Houko Kuwashima''' (Japanese: '''桑島法子''' ''Houko Kuwashima'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Houko was born on Dec 12, 1975 Iwate, Japan. Houko became a voice actor in 1988 and voiced [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] during {{aniseries|GS}} and {{aniseries|DP}}. She has also voiced [[Lucca]], [[Liko]]'s mother, in {{aniseries|HZ}}.
